biography.value:
藍龍Blue Dragon

    自負且極具領地意識的藍龍翱翔於沙漠的天空之上，時常捕食商隊並在沙漠邊際的曠野狩獵畜羣和定居者。這種龍也會出現在乾燥的草原，灼熱的荒漠以及多巖的海岸，它們會爲守衛自己的領地而對抗所有潛在的對手，特別是黃銅龍。
    藍龍以它們特色的皺褶狀耳朵，與平復額頂上的巨大獨角形象爲人所認知。數排尖刺從它鼻頭沿着額頭向腦後延伸，而在其突出的下顎也長着成簇的尖刺。
    藍龍的鱗色從閃耀的天藍到深沉的靛藍各不相同，並且由於沙漠的風沙而打磨得光滑閃亮。龍鱗隨年齡的增長而逐漸變厚增大，它的龍皮膚也隨之發出嗡嗡聲並迸裂出靜電火花。當藍龍發怒或即將攻擊時，該效應會更加強烈，甚至會在空氣中產生臭氧和灰塵的氣味。

    自負而致命Vain and Deadly。藍龍無法容忍任何明示或暗示其低弱的評價，同時又非常享受以其力量凌駕於類人生物或其他低等生物之上。
    藍龍是充滿耐心和條理的戰鬥者。它們以自己的方式戰鬥時，會將戰鬥延伸爲數小時甚至數天。它們從遠處發動閃電掃射攻擊，然後飛出傷害範圍等待下一次進攻機會。

    沙漠捕食者Desert Predators。雖然有時也會食用仙人掌或其他沙漠植物，但藍龍確實是肉食性的生物。它們喜歡捕食羣居的動物，並在吞食它們前使用閃電吐息進行烹飪。藍龍敏銳的龍眼配合廣闊的沙漠環境使其更便於搜尋食物與財寶，而其肉食習性更是使之成爲沙漠商隊和遊牧部族的巨大威脅。
    狩獵時，藍龍會將自己埋進沙中而只將鼻上的獨角露出地面，僞裝成突出的岩石。一旦獵物靠近，藍龍便起身攻擊，其身上的砂礫便如雪崩般從翅膀上抖落。

    霸主與手下Overlords and Minions。藍龍貪求那些有能力有天賦的生物來爲其服務，並以此提升自己的優越感。遊吟詩人、智者、藝術家、法師以及刺客等可以成爲藍龍重要的代理人，而這些人物通常也以忠誠的服務換得豐厚的獎賞。
    藍龍的巢穴通常會保持隱祕以確保安全，哪怕其最信任的僕從也很少有機會進入其中。它們鼓勵掘地蟲ankhegs、巨蠍giant scorpions和其它沙漠生物在其巢穴附近棲息，並以此作爲額外的安保手段。更老練的藍龍有時還會吸引氣元素和其它生物前來爲其服務。

    寶石囤積者Hoarders of Gems。藍龍會收集任何看起來有價值的東西，其中卻特別偏愛寶石。它們認爲藍色是最尊貴最美麗的顏色，因而渴求藍寶石sapphires，寵愛使用這種寶石裝飾的首飾以及魔法物品。
    藍龍將其最貴重的寶石埋藏在沙層深處，而只將一些稍低價的飾品零散的隱藏在視線可及的流沙坑裏，以應對並排除可能到來的竊賊。

藍龍巢穴A Blue Dragon’s Lair

    藍龍將其巢穴建在荒漠地區，並使用其閃電吐息和掘穴能力在沙層之下開鑿出結晶化的洞穴和地道。
    暴怒的閃電風暴環繞着傳奇藍龍的巢穴，其中還排列着許多玻璃沙材質的細管作爲巢穴的通風管，而所有這一切都會避開作爲龍第一道防線的致命流沙坑。
    藍龍會在其巢穴遭入侵時崩壞這些作爲其巢穴的洞窟。它們自己可以隨時以掘穴能力離開，只留下入侵者遭受碾壓與窒息。當它們過後再返回時就可以隨手回收一切包括死掉的入侵者身上的財物。

色彩龍Chromatic Dragons

    

黑龍、藍龍、綠龍、紅龍和白龍代表着龍類邪惡方勢力。好鬥、貪婪、自負的色彩龍是黑暗賢者或強大暴君，以恐懼壓迫衆生——包括它們的同類。

    貪婪爲動力Driven by Greed。色彩龍迷戀財寶，這種貪婪本質會貫徹它們的每項計劃和陰謀中。它們認爲自己有權佔有世界上所有的財富，因此色彩龍抓獲這些被類人或其他生物“偷”走的財寶時無需半點遲疑。這些成堆的錢幣、耀眼的寶石和魔法裝備，即是傳說中的巨龍寶庫。此外，色彩龍對商務活動毫無興趣，其積累財富單純是爲了擁有而並非爲了其他。

    自負的生物Creatures of Ego。色彩龍們一致承認自身族類的優越性，相信自己是凡間生物中的至高志強者。與其他生物互動時，它們也只關注自身利益的得失。色彩龍們堅信自己具有與生俱來的統治權，而這種信念正是其世界觀的基石。讓色彩龍謙虛就如同說服風停止吹動。在它們看來，類人生物只是動物，只適合作爲獵物和馱獸且完全不值得尊重。

    危險的巢穴Dangerous Lairs。龍的巢穴相當去其權利的寶座，也是其儲存財寶的寶庫。雖然龍類可以憑着其天生的耐性與韌性承受各種惡劣環境效應，但它們還是築起巢穴以作防守而非安居。此外，這些巢穴都會設置多個出入口，其內還爲其寶庫設置了安保措施。
    色彩龍的巢穴大多建在危險的偏遠地區，以防止那些最大膽的凡人前來拜訪。黑龍會將巢穴建在一片廣闊沼澤中央，而紅龍則可能佔據活火山的噴發口作其巢穴。除依靠大自然防禦巢穴外，一些強大的色彩龍還會使用魔法守衛、陷阱和其他順從的生物作爲巢穴的護衛。

    惡龍女王Queen of Evil Dragons。龍後提亞馬特Tiamat the Dragon Queen是邪惡龍 類的主神。她定居於九層地獄的第一層阿佛納斯Avernus中。作爲一名弱等神力，提亞馬特可以授予其崇拜者法術，只是她並不喜歡分享自己的力量。她是所有惡龍貪婪的集合體，自認爲多元宇宙和其中所有的寶藏終有一天都將成爲她獨享的所有物。
    提亞馬特是一頭體型龐大的巨龍。它的五顆頭顱反映了崇拜她的色彩龍——黑龍、藍龍、綠龍、紅龍和白龍。她的五種吐息武器可以消滅一整支軍隊，加上其可怕的施法能力以及駭人的龍爪使其成爲戰場上的恐懼之源。
    提亞馬特最痛恨的敵人，鉑金龍巴哈姆特Bahamut the Platinum Dragon，同時也是與她分享所有龍類信仰的存在。另外，她也保留着對阿斯蒙蒂斯Asmodeus的特殊恨意——後者在很久之前，爲了限制龍後的力量而剝奪了她對阿佛納斯的統治權。
龍Dragons

    真龍是擁有古老血統和驚人力量的有翼爬行類。它們以狡詐貪婪的掠奪者形象而威名遠揚，而最古老的龍也可以作爲其所在世界最強大的生物。龍類還包含了其他一些天生具有強大力量，可以使用恐怖吐息武器或其它超自然能力的魔法生物。
    許多生物（包括飛龍wyverns和龍龜dragon turtles）都擁有龍族血統。而真龍則只包括金屬龍和色彩龍兩大類別。黑龍、藍龍、綠龍、紅龍和白龍全都自私邪惡，而又令人恐懼。黃銅龍、青銅龍、赤銅龍、金龍和銀龍則體現着高貴與善良，而且睿智又令人敬畏。
    儘管它們的目標和理想千差萬別，但所有的真龍都貪戀財富，會收集成堆的錢幣並收集寶石、首飾和魔法道具。囤積了大量財寶的龍不大部分時間都呆在其寶庫中，而只有在巡視和覓食時纔會走出其巢穴。
    真龍的整個生命週期貫穿其四個不同的年齡階段，一條龍從弱小的雛龍到遠古龍可以存活長達一千年。在此期間，它們的實力將逐漸變得無可匹敵，而其財富也會超值增長。

巢穴動作Lair Actions

    先攻輪到20時（出現等值時視爲後手），該龍可執行一個巢穴動作併產生下列效應其一。它不能在連續兩輪裏重複使用同一種效應：

藍龍周邊120尺範圍內，它能看見的一個生物頭頂上一部分天花板坍塌下來。該生物必須進行一次DC 15的敏捷豁免，豁免失敗則受到10（3d6）點鈍擊傷害，並應擊倒地且被掩埋。被掩埋的目標陷入束縛，且無法呼吸或起立。該生物可以執行一個動作以進行一次DC 10的力量檢定，檢定成功即終止該被掩埋的狀況。

藍龍周邊120尺範圍內它能看見的一點升起流沙旋渦凝聚成的雲團，覆蓋以該點爲中心一處半徑20尺的球狀區域，並蔓延至該區域的每個角落。區域內的每個生物都必須進行一次DC 15的體質豁免，豁免失敗者將陷入目盲1分鐘。該生物可以在其每個自己回合結束時再進行一次該豁免，豁免成功則終止該效應。

藍龍巢穴中它能看見的兩處固態表面之間生成一道閃電弧光覆蓋其間5尺寬的線裝區域。兩處地點必須位於該龍周邊120尺範圍內，且彼此之間的間隔必須在120尺內。該區域內的每個生物都必須進行一次DC 15的敏捷豁免，豁免失敗者將受到10（3d6）點閃電傷害。

取決於您的意願，一條傳奇（成年或遠古）藍龍可以在其巢穴內使用以下一種或多種巢穴動作：

誤導幻象Misleading Mirage。在下一次先攻輪到20前，巢穴的每個岔路或分道，龍以外的生物都會有50%的幾率去到他不想去的另一個方向。

突發陷坑Sudden Sinkhole。龍選擇其120尺範圍內可視的地面一點。以該點爲中心產生一個半徑5尺，深20尺的陷坑。其上的生物需要進行一次DC15的敏捷豁免。如果豁免失敗則跌入坑底，受到7（2d6）鈍擊傷害並倒地。豁免成功的生物會移動到附近一處未被佔據的空間而非落入坑中。

區域效應Regional Effects

這片區域由於其內一個傳奇藍龍的巢穴而被魔法扭曲，造成了下列一項或多項的效應：

巢穴周邊6裏範圍內肆虐着雷暴。

巢穴周邊6裏範圍內的大地受塵暴dust devil沖刷。塵暴擁有氣元素的資料，但它無法飛行，擁有速度50尺，而其智力和魅力爲1（-5）。

隱蔽的陷洞生成於巢穴內外。陷洞可以在安全距離外以DC 20的感知（察覺）檢定發現。否則，第一個踩到陷洞上薄蓋的生物必須進行一次DC 15的敏捷豁免，豁免失敗者將墜入陷洞並跌落1d6×10尺深的距離。

龍死亡後，塵暴便會立即消失，而雷暴會在1d10日內逐漸弱化消失。

作爲《怪物圖鑑》所描述效應的追加或替代，以下這些效應中的任何一個都可能出現在藍龍巢穴周圍的區域：

藍欲Blue Luster。在龍巢1英里範圍生活超過一年的生物渾身會覺得藍色的物體很有吸引力，並有一種抓到機會就去獲取他們的衝動。

海市蜃樓Mirage Terrain。巢穴周圍的區域看起來是一片茂盛的綠洲。仔細檢查這個幻象的生物可以用DC15的智力（調查）檢定來看穿他。在辨出幻覺的生物看來，它是一個疊加在原本地形上的模糊影像。

沙塵暴Sandstorm。在龍巢1英里範圍內不斷有沙暴吹襲。

定製龍類Customizing Dragons FTD p33

正如《地下城主指南》中所說，你可以定製任何龍的數據以反映龍的獨特能力。像下面這樣的小改動是很容易做到的，而且對龍的挑戰等級沒有影響。

語言Laanguages。大多數龍喜歡說龍語，但爲了與盟友和僕從打交道同樣也需要學習通用語。鑑於龍的高智力和長壽命，它們可以很容易地學習其他語言。你可以將一些額外語言添加到龍的資料卡中。

技能Skills。大多數龍都具有察覺和隱匿技能的熟練項，許多龍還有額外的技能熟練。和語言一樣，你可以定製龍的技能列表（甚至將他們對某些技能的熟練翻倍）以反映其特殊的興趣和技巧。你也可以給龍提供工具熟練，特別是當龍在人形狀態下花費了一段時間訓練時。

法術Spells。《怪物圖鑑》中關於讓龍成爲天生的施法者的變體規則是一種簡單的方法，可以在不影響龍的挑戰等級的情況下爲其增加多樣性。第5章爲不同種類的龍提供了建議的法術列表，但你也可以選擇法術來反映龍的特性。一條天生施展德魯伊法術的龍與施展術士法術的龍給人的感覺會截然不同。你也可以給龍提供比這個變體規則所允許的更高等級的法術，但這樣的調整可能會增加龍的挑戰等級——尤其是當這些法術能直接對目標造成傷害或施加各類增益/減益時。

其他特質和動作Other Traits and Actions。你可以借用其他怪物的特性和行動來爲龍增加獨特的風味。考慮一下這些例子。

變形Change Shape。你可以決定讓龍在比平時更小的年齡獲得這個動作，特別是想在你的戰役中靠類人形態來塑造龍類時。本章後面的 "變形 "部分提供了更多信息和靈感。(參見《怪物圖鑑》中的金屬龍Metallic Dragons）。)

傷害吸收Damage Absorption。你也許會令紅龍或金龍不僅不受火焰傷害，甚至還能被烈焰治癒。(參見《怪物圖鑑》中的肉身魔像Flesh Golem）。)

飛掠Flyby。龍那超凡的飛行技巧使其能迅速飛出敵人的威脅範圍。(參見《怪物圖鑑》中的鹿鷹獸peryton）。)

擬聲Mimicry。對狡猾的龍來說，模仿冒險者或他們的盟友可能是一個有趣並且的確有用的技巧。(參見《怪物圖鑑》中的天狗Kenku）。)

復生Rejuvenation。在你的戰役中，你可能會將作爲物質位面重要組分的龍類設定爲幾乎不可能被完全殺死的存在。就像巫妖的靈魂被保存在命匣裏一樣，龍的生命精華可能會被保存在它最初出現的蛋裏、它的寶庫裏，或者世界中心的一個巨大洞穴裏。(參見《怪物圖鑑》中的巫妖Lich。)

特殊感官Special Sense。大多數龍都有盲視和黑暗視覺。你可以將黑暗視覺升級爲真實視覺，或者你可以給一條有掘地速度的龍賦予顫動感知。(見《怪物圖鑑》的相關介紹）。)

掘道者Tunneler。任何具有掘地速度的龍都可以具有這種特性，即，在堅硬的岩石中移動，並在其後面挖出一條隧道。(參見《怪物圖鑑》中的土巨怪umber hulk）。)

變體：龍類天生施法者Variant: Dragons as Innate Spellcasters

遠古藍龍天生可以施展法術，且不需任何材料成分。而該法術的環階也不能超過7階。 該龍的法術豁免DC等於 20，該龍的法術攻擊加值+12。

《怪物圖鑑》中關於讓龍成爲天生的施法者的變體規則是一種簡單的方法，可以在不影響龍的挑戰等級的情況下爲其增加多樣性。第5章爲不同種類的龍提供了建議的法術列表，但你也可以選擇法術來反映龍的特性。一條天生施展德魯伊法術的龍與施展術士法術的龍給人的感覺會截然不同。你也可以給龍提供比這個變體規則所允許的更高等級的法術，但這樣的調整可能會增加龍的挑戰等級——尤其是當這些法術能直接對目標造成傷害或施加各類增益/減益時。示例如下：

  • 祕法眼 arcane eye
  • 造水/枯水術 create or destroy water
  • 高等幻影 major image
  • 投影術 project image

Source: FTD

變體：龍類天生施法者Variant: Dragons as Innate Spellcasters

    龍作爲天生的魔法生物，其隨着年齡的增長可能會逐漸掌握一些法術，此時便可以使用該變體。
    一條青年龍或更年長的龍天生可以施展的法術數量等同於其魅力調整值。每個法術每日只能施展一次，且不需任何材料成分，而該法術的環階也不能超過這條龍挑戰等級的三分之一（向下取整）。該龍的法術攻擊加值等於其熟練加值＋其魅力調整值。該龍的法術豁免DC等於8＋其熟練加值＋其魅力調整值。

這條遠古藍龍天生可以施展法術，且不需任何材料成分。而該法術的環階也不能超過7階。 該龍的法術豁免DC等於 20，該龍的法術攻擊加值+12。請參閱“法術”頁面，以獲取該龍能夠獲得的法術。示例如下：

  • 連鎖閃電 chain lightning
  • 力場監牢 forcecage
  • 傳送術 teleport
  • 以太化 etherealness

Vain and territorial, blue dragons soar through the skies over deserts, preying on caravans and plundering herds and settlements in the verdant lands beyond the desert's reach. These dragons can also be found in dry steppes, searing badlands, and rocky coasts. They guard their territories against all potential competitors, especially brass dragons.

A blue dragon is recognized by its dramatic frilled ears and the massive ridged horn atop its blunt head. Rows of spikes extend back from its nostrils to line its brow, and cluster on its jutting lower jaw.

A blue dragon's scales vary in color from an iridescent azure to a deep indigo, polished to a glossy finish by the desert sands. As the dragon ages, its scales become thicker and harder, and its hide hums and crackles with static electricity. These effects intensify when the dragon is angry or about to attack, giving off an odor of ozone and dusty air.

Vain and Deadly. A blue dragon will not stand for any remark or insinuation that it is weak or inferior, taking great pleasure in lording its power over humanoids and other lesser creatures.

A blue dragon is a patient and methodical combatant. When fighting on its own terms, it turns combat into an extended affair of hours or even days, attacking from a distance with volleys of lightning, then flying well out of harm's reach as it waits to attack again.

Desert Predators. Though they sometimes eat cacti and other desert plants to sate their great hunger, blue dragons are carnivores. They prefer to dine on herd animals, cooking those creatures with their lightning breath before gorging themselves. Their dining habits make blue dragons an enormous threat to desert caravans and nomadic tribes, which become convenient collections of food and treasure to a dragon's eye.

When it hunts, a blue dragon buries itself in the desert sand so that only the horn on its nose pokes above the surface, appearing to be an outcropping of stone. When prey draws near, the dragon rises up, sand pouring from its wings like an avalanche as it attacks.

Overlords and Minions. Blue dragons covet valuable and talented creatures whose service reinforces their sense of superiority. Bards, sages, artists, wizards, and assassins can become valuable agents for a blue dragon, which rewards loyal service handsomely.

A blue dragon keeps its lair secret and well protected, and even its most trusted servants are rarely allowed within. It encourages ankhegs, giant scorpions, and other creatures of the desert to dwell near its lair for additional security. Older blue dragons sometimes attract air elementals and other creatures to serve them.

Hoarders of Gems. Though blue dragons collect anything that looks valuable, they are especially fond of gems. Considering blue to be the most noble and beautiful of colors, they covet sapphires, favoring jewelery and magic items adorned with those gems.

A blue dragon buries its most valuable treasures deep in the sand, while scattering a few less valuable trinkets in plainer sight over hidden sinkholes to punish and eliminate would-be thieves.

A Blue Dragon's Lair

Blue dragons make their lairs in barren places, using their lightning breath and their burrowing ability to carve out crystallized caverns and tunnels beneath the sands.

Thunderstorms rage around a legendary blue dragon's lair, and narrow tubes lined with glassy sand ventilate the lair, all the while avoiding the deadly sinkholes that are the dragon's first line of defense.

A blue dragon will collapse the caverns that make up its lair if that lair is invaded. The dragon then burrows out, leaving its attackers to be crushed and suffocated. When it returns later, it collects its possessions-along with the wealth of the dead intruders.

Chromatic Dragons

The black, blue, green, red, and white dragons represent the evil side of dragonkind. Aggressive, gluttonous, and vain, chromatic dragons are dark sages and powerful tyrants feared by all creatures-including each other.

Driven by Greed. Chromatic dragons lust after treasure, and this greed colors their every scheme and plot. They believe that the world's wealth belongs to them by right, and a chromatic dragon seizes that wealth without regard for the humanoids and other creatures that have "stolen" it. With its piles of coins, gleaming gems, and magic items, a dragon's hoard is the stuff of legend. However, chromatic dragons have no interest in commerce, amassing wealth for no other reason than to have it.

Creatures of Ego. Chromatic dragons are united by their sense of superiority, believing themselves the most powerful and worthy of all mortal creatures. When they interact with other creatures, it is only to further their own interests. They believe in their innate right to rule, and this belief is the cornerstone of every chromatic dragon's personality and worldview. Trying to humble a chromatic dragon is like trying to convince the wind to stop blowing. To these creatures, humanoids are animals, fit to serve as prey or beasts of burden, and wholly unworthy of respect.

Dangerous Lairs. A dragon's lair serves as the seat of its power and a vault for its treasure. With its innate toughness and tolerance for severe environmental effects, a dragon selects or builds a lair not for shelter but for defense, favoring multiple entrances and exits, and security for its hoard.

Most chromatic dragon lairs are hidden in dangerous and remote locations to prevent all but the most audacious mortals from reaching them. A black dragon might lair in the heart of a vast swamp, while a red dragon might claim the caldera of an active volcano. In addition to the natural defenses of their lairs, powerful chromatic dragons use magical guardians, traps, and subservient creatures to protect their treasures.

Queen of Evil Dragons. Tiamat the Dragon Queen is the chief deity of evil dragonkind. She dwells on Avernus, the first layer of the Nine Hells. As a lesser god, Tiamat has the power to grant spells to her worshipers, though she is loath to share her power. She epitomizes the avarice of evil dragons, believing that the multiverse and all its treasures will one day be hers and hers alone.

Tiamat is a gigantic dragon whose five heads reflect the forms of the chromatic dragons that worship her-black, blue, green, red, and white. She is a terror on the battlefield, capable of annihilating whole armies with her five breath weapons, her formidable spellcasting, and her fearsome claws.

Tiamat's most hated enemy is Bahamut the Platinum Dragon, with whom she shares control of the faith of dragonkind. She also holds a special enmity for Asmodeus, who long ago stripped her of the rule of Avernus and who continues to curb the Dragon Queen's power.

Dragons

True dragons are winged reptiles of ancient lineage and fearsome power. They are known and feared for their predatory cunning and greed, with the oldest dragons accounted as some of the most powerful creatures in the world. Dragons are also magical creatures whose innate power fuels their dreaded breath weapons and other preternatural abilities.

Many creatures, including wyverns and dragon turtles, have draconic blood. However, true dragons fall into the two broad categories of chromatic and metallic dragons. The black, blue, green, red, and white dragons are selfish, evil, and feared by all. The brass, bronze, copper, gold, and silver dragons are noble, good, and highly respected by the wise.

Though their goals and ideals vary tremendously, all true dragons covet wealth, hoarding mounds of coins and gathering gems, jewels, and magic items. Dragons with large hoards are loath to leave them for long, venturing out of their lairs only to patrol or feed.

True dragons pass through four distinct stages of life, from lowly wyrmlings to ancient dragons, which can live for over a thousand years. In that time, their might can become unrivaled and their hoards can grow beyond price.

Lair Actions

On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the dragon takes a lair action to cause one of the following effects; the dragon can't use the same effect two rounds in a row:

  • Part of the ceiling collapses above one creature that the dragon can see within 120 feet of it. The creature must succeed on a [[/save ability=dex dc=15]] saving throw or take 10 ([[/damage 3d6 type=bludgeoning]]) damage and be knocked &Reference[condition=prone] and buried. The buried target is &Reference[condition=restrained] and unable to breathe or stand up. A creature can take an action to make a [[/save ability=str dc=10]] check, ending the buried state on a success.
  • A cloud of sand swirls about in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point the dragon can see within 120 feet of it. The cloud spreads around corners. Each creature in the cloud must succeed on a [[/save ability=con dc=15]] saving throw or be &Reference[condition=blinded] for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
  • Lightning arcs, forming a 5-foot-wide line between two of the lair's solid surfaces that the dragon can see. They must be within 120 feet of the dragon and 120 feet of each other. Each creature in that line must succeed on a [[/save ability=dex dc=15]] saving throw or take 10 ([[/damage 3d6 type=lightning]]) damage.

Additional Lair Actions. At your discretion, a legendary (@creature[Adult Blue Dragon||adult] or @creature[Ancient Blue Dragon||ancient]) blue dragon can use one or both of the following additional lair actions while in its lair:

  • Misleading Mirage. Until initiative count 20 on the next round, at each intersection or branching passage in the lair, a creature other than the dragon has a [[/r 1d100]]{50 percent} chance of going in a different direction from the direction it intends.

  • Sudden Sinkhole. The dragon chooses a point on the ground that it can see within 120 feet of it. A 5-foot-radius, 20-foot-deep pit forms centered on that point. A creature on the ground above where the pit formed must make a [[/save ability=dex dc=15]] saving throw. On a failed save, a creature falls to the bottom of the pit, taking 7 ([[/damage 2d6 type=bludgeoning]]) damage and landing &Reference[condition=prone]. On a successful save, a creature moves to the nearest unoccupied space instead of falling in the pit.

Regional Effects

The region containing a legendary blue dragon's lair is warped by the dragon's magic, which creates one or more of the following effects:

  • Thunderstorms rage within 6 miles of the lair.
  • Dust devils scour the land within 6 miles of the lair. A dust devil has the statistics of an air elemental, but it can't fly, has a speed of 50 feet, and has an Intelligence and Charisma of 1 (-5).
  • Hidden sinkholes form in and around the dragon's lair. A sinkhole can be spotted from a safe distance with a successful [[/save ability=wis dc=20]] (&Reference[skill=Perception]) check. Otherwise, the first creature to step on the thin crust covering the sinkhole must succeed on a [[/save ability=dex dc=15]] saving throw or fall [[/r 1d6 * 10]]{1d6 × 10} feet into the sinkhole.

If the dragon dies, the dust devils disappear immediately, and the thunderstorms abate within [[/r 1d10]] days. Any sinkholes remain where they are.

Additional Regional Effects. Any of these effects might appear in the area around a blue dragon's lair, in addition to or instead of the effects described in the Monster Manual:

  • Blue Luster. Creatures that spend a year within 1 mile of the dragon's lair find blue objects fascinating and feel compelled to acquire them at every opportunity.

  • Mirage Terrain. The area immediately surrounding the lair appears to be a lush oasis. A creature carefully examining the illusion can attempt a [[/save ability=int dc=15]] (&Reference[skill=Investigation]) check to disbelieve it. A creature who disbelieves the illusion sees it as a vague image superimposed on the underlying terrain.

  • Sandstorm. A sandstorm blows constantly within 1 mile of the dragon's lair.

Customizing Dragons FTD p33[–]

You can customize any dragon's stat block to reflect the dragon's unique character. Minor changes such as those below are easy to make and have no impact on a dragon's challenge rating.

Languages. Most dragons prefer to speak Draconic but learn Common for dealing with allies and minions. But given their high Intelligence and long life span, dragons can easily learn additional languages. You can add languages to a dragon's stat block.

Skills. Most dragons are proficient in the Perception and Stealth skills, and many dragons have additional skill proficiencies. As with languages, you can customize a dragon's skill list (even doubling their proficiency bonus with certain skills) to reflect particular interests and activities. You can also give a dragon tool proficiencies, particularly if the dragon spends time in Humanoid form.

Spells. See the "Variant: Dragons as Innate Spellcasters" inset(s), below.

Other Traits and Actions. You can borrow traits and actions from other monsters to add unique flavor to a dragon. Consider these examples:

  • Flyby. The dragon is an agile flier, quick to fly out of enemies' reach.The dragon doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

  • Mimicry. Impersonating characters or their allies could be a fun trick for a crafty dragon.The dragon can mimic any sounds it has heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 13 Wisdom (Insight) check.

  • Rejuvenation. You might decide that dragons in your campaign, being an essential part of the Material Plane, are nearly impossible to destroy. A dragon's life essence might be preserved in the egg from which it first emerged, in its hoard, or in a cavernous hall at the center of the world, just as a lich's essence is hidden in a phylactery.If it has an essence-preserving object, a destroyed dragon gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the object.

  • Special Senses. Most dragons have blindsight and darkvision. You might upgrade blindsight to truesight, or you could give a dragon with a burrowing speed tremorsense.

  • Tunneler. The dragon can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a tunnel in its wake.

Variant: Dragons as Innate Spellcasters[–]

This dragon can innately cast five spells, once per day each, requiring no material components. Each spell's level can be no higher than 7th. The dragon's spell save DC is DC 20, and it has +12 to hit with spell attacks.

A suggested spell list is shown below, but you can also choose spells to reflect the dragon's character. A dragon who innately casts druid spells feels different from one who casts warlock spells. You can also give a dragon spells of a higher level than this rule allows, but such a tweak might increase the dragon's challenge rating—especially if those spells deal damage or impose conditions on targets.

  • arcane eye
  • create or destroy water
  • major image
  • project image

Source: FTD

Variant: Dragons as Innate Spellcasters[–]

Dragons are innately magical creatures that can master a few spells as they age, using this variant.

A young or older dragon can innately cast a number of spells equal to its Charisma modifier. Each spell can be cast once per day, requiring no material components, and the spell's level can be no higher than one-third the dragon's challenge rating (rounded down). The dragon's bonus to hit with spell attacks is equal to its proficiency bonus + its Charisma bonus. The dragon's spell save DC equals 8 + its proficiency bonus + its Charisma modifier.

This dragon can innately cast five spells, once per day each, requiring no material components. Each spell's level can be no higher than 7th. The dragon's spell save DC is DC 20, and it has +12 to hit with spell attacks. See the spell page for a list of spells the dragon is capable of casting. A selection of examples are shown below:

  • chain lightning
  • forcecage
  • teleport
  • etherealness

Each creature in the cloud must succeed on a [[/save ability=con dc=15]] saving throw or be &Reference[condition=blinded] for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

在下一次先攻輪到20前，巢穴的每個岔路或分道，龍以外的生物都會有[[/r 1d100]]{50 percent} 的幾率去到他不想去的另一個方向。

Until initiative count 20 on the next round, at each intersection or branching passage in the lair, a creature other than the dragon has a [[/r 1d100]]{50 percent} chance of going in a different direction from the direction it intends.

龍選擇其120尺範圍內可視的地面一點。以該點爲中心產生一個半徑5尺，深20尺的陷坑。其上的生物需要進行一次 [[/save ability=dex dc=15]]的敏捷豁免。如果豁免失敗則跌入坑底，受到7([[/damage 2d6 type=bludgeoning]])鈍擊傷害並倒地&Reference[condition=prone]。豁免成功的生物會移動到附近一處未被佔據的空間而非落入坑中。

The dragon chooses a point on the ground that it can see within 120 feet of it. A 5-foot-radius, 20-foot-deep pit forms centered on that point. A creature on the ground above where the pit formed must make a [[/save ability=dex dc=15]] saving throw. On a failed save, a creature falls to the bottom of the pit, taking 7 ([[/damage 2d6 type=bludgeoning]]) damage and landing &Reference[condition=prone]. On a successful save, a creature moves to the nearest unoccupied space instead of falling in the pit.

items.name: 閃電風暴Lightning arcs, forming a 5-foot-wide line between ...

description.value:
藍龍巢穴中它能看見的兩處固態表面之間生成一道閃電弧光覆蓋其間5尺寬的線狀區域。兩處地點必須位於該龍周邊120尺範圍內，且彼此之間的間隔必須在120尺內。該區域內的每個生物都必須進行一次[[/save ability=dex dc=15]]的敏捷豁免，豁免失敗者將受到10([[/damage 3d6 type=lightning]])點閃電傷害。

Lightning arcs, forming a 5-foot-wide line between two of the lair's solid surfaces that the dragon can see. They must be within 120 feet of the dragon and 120 feet of each other. Each creature in that line must succeed on a [[/save ability=dex dc=15]] saving throw or take 10 ([[/damage 3d6 type=lightning]]) damage.
